scope: Proposition 12.14 (Representation-coefficient tails from entropy) of the manuscript “Random coordinate frames and partial permutation laws” (preprints/Random-coordinate-frames-and-partial-permutation-laws-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0a520da2d4a92a17), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 50-51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute C such that for every irreducible unitary representation ρ of G, of degree D, and unit vectors u, z, P{Gent, |⟨z, ρ(gT )u⟩| ≥ D−1/8 } ≤ CD−1/(2L) . (12.18) 50 Put a = P(Gent). When a > 0, the conditional endpoint law η = L(gT | Gent) is defined and satisfies ∥b η(ρ)∥op ≤ D−1/8 + C a D−1/(2L) . For all sufficiently large d, Lemma 12.12 gives a ≥ 1/2. In that range the last bound is at most C′D−1/(2L) for the absolute constant C′ = 1 + 2C.
